mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) may inhibit febuxostat metabolism via CYP1A2 and CYP2C9, increasing febuxostat levels and risk of xanthine oxidase inhibition complications; additive potential for hypertension and serotonergic effects if febuxostat has minor serotonergic properties.
action: Monitor closely for febuxostat toxicity, hyperuricemia rebound, and hypertensive episodes; consider alternative xanthine oxidase inhibitor (allopurinol) with MAOI or ensure adequate washout periods if switching.
